row: Welcome to Delmar Chiropractic YouTube Channel where Dr. Tim Talmage shows you excellent exercises, stretches and proper posture. The Delmar Chiropractic office is located just outside Albany, NY in the heart of Delmar, at 204 Delaware Avenue. The leading health professionals at Delmar Chiropractic are dedicated to helping you achieve your wellness objectives -- combining skill and expertise that spans the entire chiropractic wellness spectrum. Dr. Tim Talmage, Dr. Bob Irwin and Dr. Michael Ashline are committed to bringing you better health and a better way of life by teaching and practicing the true principles of chiropractic wellness care. Visit us online at http://www.delmarchiropractic.com or call for an appointment 518-439-7644
